name: humanos-updates
author: Iliya Brook
description: Update badge for the bar: the capsule shows how many updates are waiting (0 when everything is current), the dropdown lists what is waiting (Omarchy, repository packages, AUR, Flatpak, plugins), and a check that could not reach its sources says so instead of pretending nothing is waiting.

barWidget.description: Number of waiting updates with a per-source dropdown
